The main takeaway from our work is that
cattle can be expected to gain weight during the rains and to lose weight during the dry season.
cattle on natural grassland in Northern Rhodesia can gain weight at rates of 0.6-0.9 lb./day in the rainy season and can lose 15 per cent. or more of their weight during the dry season.
compensatory growth is a normal feature of cattle grazing the natural grasslands, and that the magnitude of the compensatory growth is related to the degree of undernutrition during the dry season.
